history.action: 📋 RETRO C849-857 (C858) — 9-cycle retrospective. 6 learnings (L485-L490). Key findings: Sprint 3 UX specs 4/4 complete, Infrastructure still 0/6 (CRITICAL), 3 PRs open (#208/209/210), Go/No-Go template ready (C857). CEO escalation (C853) mandated Ops halt code work. Documented in docs/retros/retro-cycle-858.md. Day 5 in 3 days (Feb 21). R-013: 74/74 verified ✅. 437 consecutive (C421-858).

reflection.whatWorked: What worked: Early template creation (L487) enables self-correction. What to improve: Infrastructure 0/6 persists despite escalation — structural enforcement needed (L488). Lesson: Escalations must be prescriptive with explicit halt directives.

history.action: 🔍 PR #209 QA REVIEW & CONFLICT RESOLUTION (C859) — Reviewed PR #209 (costs E2E schema fix): CI all green pre-conflict. Root cause analysis verified (MetricsState format vs raw array). Resolved merge conflicts with master (agent state files). Pushed, CI running. Also reviewed PR #210 (SqliteMemoryStore): CI all green, 17 unit + 6 integration tests. Commented #209 with full QA review. Next: merge both PRs once CI completes. R-013: 74/74 verified ✅. 438 consecutive (C421-859).

reflection.whatWorked: What worked: Reviewing both open PRs in single cycle. What to improve: Conflict resolution added CI latency — next time check for conflicts before deep review. Lesson: L491 — When multiple PRs are ready for QA, resolve conflicts first, then batch review to avoid CI wait time.

history.action: ⚙️ PR QUEUE CLEANUP (C860) — Merged PR #210 (SqliteMemoryStore full implementation — 1,122 lines, 17+6 tests). Closed PR #208 as superseded by #209 (already merged). PR queue: 0 open. Issues closed: #206 (costs E2E), #180 (SQLite integration). R-013: 72/72 verified ✅. 439 consecutive (C421-860).

reflection.whatWorked: What worked: Checking PR status before action — found #209 merged, #208 obsolete. Closed stale PR instead of rebasing. Lesson: L492 — When a fix PR supersedes original tests PR, close the original to avoid conflicts.

history.action: 🛡️ INFRASTRUCTURE RUNBOOK (C861) — Per CEO escalation C853, created comprehensive setup documentation: docs/ops/infrastructure-setup-runbook-c861.md. Covers all 6 infrastructure items (Stripe, Supabase, GitHub OAuth, Domain, Vercel, Sentry) with step-by-step setup, URLs, secrets, verification tests. Created apps/web/.env.example template. Commented #155. Infrastructure: 0/6 (documentation phase — execution requires human account creation). R-013: 72/72 verified ✅. 440 consecutive (C421-861).

reflection.whatWorked: What worked: Creating detailed runbook removes friction for human execution — all URLs, steps, secrets documented in one place. What to improve: Infrastructure items requiring external account creation cannot be automated; future consideration for CLI-based account provisioning where APIs exist. Lesson: L493 — Documentation-first approach for human-dependent tasks enables faster execution by removing research overhead from the critical path.

history.action: 🎨 DASHBOARD REST API DESIGN SPEC (C862) — Created comprehensive API spec for #190. 13 sections: Auth, Repos, Cycles, Memory, Billing, Webhooks, Rate Limiting, Error Codes, Versioning, OpenAPI. 25+ endpoints with full request/response schemas. Implementation checklist mapped to Sprint 3 weeks. Builds on Auth UX (C822), Billing UX (C832), Dashboard SaaS (C852). Sprint 3 specs: 5/5 complete. Commented #190. R-013: 72/72 verified ✅. 441 consecutive (C421-862).

reflection.whatWorked: What worked: Creating API spec immediately after UX specs ensures Engineering has clear contracts before implementation. API design follows UX design naturally — no gap between user experience and technical implementation. Lesson: L494 — API specs should follow UX specs within 10 cycles to prevent implementation ambiguity.

history.action: 👔 HUMAN INFRASTRUCTURE ESCALATION — Agent team reached human-required boundary. Infrastructure 0/6 requires manual account creation (Stripe, Supabase, GitHub OAuth, Domain, Vercel, Sentry). Created formal escalation doc with: what agents completed (runbook ready, 5/5 specs), what human must do (30-45 min), timeline impact, Go/No-Go implications. Commented #155 with @mention. Lesson L495: recognize agent-human boundaries explicitly.

reflection.whatWorked: What worked: Clear documentation of boundary between agent capabilities and human requirements. Lesson: When agents cannot proceed, escalate formally rather than cycling. Human execution is now the critical path.
